changeSet.author: dcre
changeSet.createView: SELECT * FROM ( SELECT e.file_name::STRING AS file_name, COALESCE(g.client, split_part(e.file_name, '_', 1))::STRING AS client, 'OUTBOUND' AS direction, 'PAIN008' AS kind, 'fint-req' AS route, e.arrival_id, e.arrival_id AS related_arrival_id, NULL::VARCHAR(63) AS job_name, e.created_at AS occurred_at, (CASE WHEN e.visible_at IS NOT NULL THEN 'VISIBLE' ELSE e.state END)::STRING AS state, 'crw_emission' AS source_table FROM public.crw_emission e LEFT JOIN public.crw_emission_group g ON g.id = e.group_id UNION ALL SELECT r.response_file::STRING, COALESCE(g.client, split_part(r.response_file, '_', 1))::STRING, 'INBOUND', 'ISR', 'fint-resp', e.arrival_id, e.arrival_id, NULL::VARCHAR(63), min(r.created_at), 'INGESTED'::STRING, 'isr_resp' FROM public.isr_resp r LEFT JOIN public.crw_emission e ON e.id = r.emission_id LEFT JOIN public.crw_emission_group g ON g.id = e.group_id GROUP BY r.response_file, g.client, e.arrival_id UNION ALL SELECT r.response_file::STRING, COALESCE(g.client, split_part(r.response_file, '_', 1))::STRING, 'INBOUND', 'SBSR', 'fint-resp', e.arrival_id, e.arrival_id, NULL::VARCHAR(63), min(r.created_at), 'INGESTED'::STRING, 'sbsr_resp' FROM public.sbsr_resp r LEFT JOIN public.crw_emission e ON e.id = r.emission_id LEFT JOIN public.crw_emission_group g ON g.id = e.group_id GROUP BY r.response_file, g.client, e.arrival_id UNION ALL SELECT r.response_file::STRING, COALESCE(g.client, split_part(r.response_file, '_', 1))::STRING, 'INBOUND', 'PBSR', 'fint-resp', e.arrival_id, e.arrival_id, NULL::VARCHAR(63), min(r.created_at), 'INGESTED'::STRING, 'pbsr_resp' FROM public.pbsr_resp r LEFT JOIN public.crw_emission e ON e.id = r.emission_id LEFT JOIN public.crw_emission_group g ON g.id = e.group_id GROUP BY r.response_file, g.client, e.arrival_id UNION ALL SELECT c.file_name::STRING, c.client::STRING, 'OUTBOUND', 'RESP', 'onhost-resp', c.arrival_id, NULL::UUID, NULL::VARCHAR(63), COALESCE(c.written_at, c.created_at), (c.outcome || CASE WHEN c.written_at IS NULL THEN '|STAGED_NOT_WRITTEN' ELSE '' END || COALESCE('|' || c.reason, '') || CASE WHEN c.total_count IS NOT NULL THEN '|' || COALESCE(c.accepted_count, 0)::STRING || '/' || c.total_count::STRING ELSE '' END)::STRING, 'cir_response' FROM public.cir_response c UNION ALL SELECT p.file_name::STRING, p.client::STRING, 'OUTBOUND', 'PSR', 'onhost-resp', g.arrival_id, g.arrival_id, p.job_name, p.created_at, p.trigger_kind::STRING, 'prg_report' FROM public.prg_report p LEFT JOIN public.crw_emission_group g ON g.source_msg_id = p.parent_source_msg_id AND g.client = p.client UNION ALL SELECT r.job_name::STRING, 'DCRE'::STRING, 'INTERNAL', 'OUTCOME_SEAM', 'outcomes', NULL::UUID, NULL::UUID, r.job_name, r.created_at, r.outcome::STRING, 'rpt_run' FROM public.rpt_run r ) x WHERE current_user IN ('rpt_internal', 'root')

changeSet.author: dcre
changeSet.createView: SELECT * FROM ( SELECT h.arrival_id, NULL::VARCHAR(63) AS job_name, 'CRR_INGESTED' AS step, h.created_at AS step_at, NULL::STRING AS detail, h.id AS source_key, 'INGEST' AS event_kind, 'CREATED_AT' AS time_kind, NULL::UUID AS intent_id, NULL::INT AS attempt, NULL::INT AS exit_code FROM public.tx_header h UNION ALL SELECT v.arrival_id, NULL::VARCHAR(63), 'CTV_VALIDATED', max(v.created_at), (count(*)::STRING || ' checks')::STRING, NULL::UUID, 'VALIDATION', 'CREATED_AT', NULL::UUID, NULL::INT, NULL::INT FROM public.validation_log v GROUP BY v.arrival_id UNION ALL SELECT c.arrival_id, NULL::VARCHAR(63), 'CIR_RESP_STAGED', c.created_at, c.file_name::STRING, c.id, 'RESP', 'CREATED_AT', NULL::UUID, NULL::INT, NULL::INT FROM public.cir_response c UNION ALL SELECT c.arrival_id, NULL::VARCHAR(63), 'CIR_RESP_WRITTEN', c.written_at, c.file_name::STRING, c.id, 'RESP', 'WRITTEN_AT', NULL::UUID, NULL::INT, NULL::INT FROM public.cir_response c WHERE c.written_at IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT e.arrival_id, NULL::VARCHAR(63), 'CRW_PLANNED', e.created_at, e.file_name::STRING, e.id, 'EMISSION', 'CREATED_AT', NULL::UUID, NULL::INT, NULL::INT FROM public.crw_emission e UNION ALL SELECT e.arrival_id, NULL::VARCHAR(63), 'CRW_VISIBLE', e.visible_at, e.file_name::STRING, e.id, 'EMISSION', 'VISIBLE_AT', NULL::UUID, NULL::INT, NULL::INT FROM public.crw_emission e WHERE e.visible_at IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT e.arrival_id, NULL::VARCHAR(63), 'IXR_REPLY', min(r.created_at), r.response_file::STRING, NULL::UUID, 'REPLY', 'CREATED_AT', NULL::UUID, NULL::INT, NULL::INT FROM public.isr_resp r JOIN public.crw_emission e ON e.id = r.emission_id GROUP BY e.arrival_id, r.response_file UNION ALL SELECT e.arrival_id, NULL::VARCHAR(63), 'SXR_REPLY', min(r.created_at), r.response_file::STRING, NULL::UUID, 'REPLY', 'CREATED_AT', NULL::UUID, NULL::INT, NULL::INT FROM public.sbsr_resp r JOIN public.crw_emission e ON e.id = r.emission_id GROUP BY e.arrival_id, r.response_file UNION ALL SELECT e.arrival_id, NULL::VARCHAR(63), 'PXR_REPLY', min(r.created_at), r.response_file::STRING, NULL::UUID, 'REPLY', 'CREATED_AT', NULL::UUID, NULL::INT, NULL::INT FROM public.pbsr_resp r JOIN public.crw_emission e ON e.id = r.emission_id GROUP BY e.arrival_id, r.response_file UNION ALL SELECT g.arrival_id, p.job_name, 'PRG_REPORTED', p.created_at, p.file_name::STRING, p.id, 'REPORT', 'CREATED_AT', NULL::UUID, NULL::INT, NULL::INT FROM public.prg_report p LEFT JOIN public.crw_emission_group g ON g.source_msg_id = p.parent_source_msg_id AND g.client = p.client UNION ALL SELECT NULL::UUID, r.job_name, 'RPT_OUTCOME', r.created_at, r.outcome::STRING, r.id, 'SEAM', 'CREATED_AT', NULL::UUID, NULL::INT, NULL::INT FROM public.rpt_run r ) x WHERE current_user IN ('rpt_internal', 'root')
